result.instructions: Tools for Livestorm, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which webinars are scheduled for next week, and how many people are registered for each?"; "Who attended our product demo session last Tuesday, and who did not show up?"; "Show me the questions people asked in our onboarding webinar.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Livestorm data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run livestorm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run livestorm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run livestorm_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. livestorm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: livestorm_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Get the Livestorm organization (workspace) that the API token belongs to. Good first call to confirm which workspace is connected. Livestorm API: GET /organization (identity scope).

tools.name: livestorm_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the events of the workspace, with title, status (draft, published, ...), scheduling status and timestamps. Filter by title, tag or created/updated dates. Livestorm API: GET /events.

title.description: Only events whose title matches this text.

scheduling_status.description: Filter by scheduling status, as Livestorm reports it.

created_since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time (for example 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z).

created_until.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time (for example 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z).

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time (for example 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z).

updated_until.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time (for example 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z).

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to include in the response (for example 'sessions').

tools.name: livestorm_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Get one event by id: title, slug, registration link, status, recording and chat settings. Livestorm API: GET /events/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to include in the response (for example 'sessions').

tools.name: livestorm_list_event_sessions
tools.title: List event sessions
tools.description: List the sessions (single occurrences) of one event, with status and start time. Livestorm API: GET /events/{id}/sessions.

status.description: Filter by session status, as Livestorm reports it.

date_from.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time (for example 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z).

date_to.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time (for example 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z).

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to include in the response (for example 'sessions').

tools.name: livestorm_list_sessions
tools.title: List sessions
tools.description: List all sessions across the workspace, filtered by status and date range. Use it for upcoming or past sessions across all events. Livestorm API: GET /sessions.

status.description: Filter by session status, as Livestorm reports it.

date_from.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time (for example 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z).

date_to.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time (for example 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z).

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time (for example 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z).

updated_until.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time (for example 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z).

tools.name: livestorm_get_session
tools.title: Get a session
tools.description: Get one session by id: start time, timezone, status, name and duration. Livestorm API: GET /sessions/{id}.

session_id.description: The session id (from livestorm_list_sessions or livestorm_list_event_sessions).

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to include in the response (for example 'sessions').

tools.name: livestorm_list_session_people
tools.title: List session attendees
tools.description: List the registrants and attendees of one session, with role and attendance. Filter to attended people or to one email. Livestorm API: GET /sessions/{id}/people.

role.description: Filter by role, as Livestorm reports it (for example 'attendee').

attended.description: true = only people who attended, false = only people who did not.

email.description: Only the person with this email address.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to include in the response (for example 'sessions').

tools.name: livestorm_list_session_questions
tools.title: List session questions
tools.description: List the questions that attendees asked in one session. Livestorm API: GET /sessions/{id}/questions.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to include in the response (for example 'sessions').

tools.name: livestorm_list_session_recordings
tools.title: List session recordings
tools.description: List the recordings of one session. Each recording URL is signed and expires after url_expires_in seconds. Livestorm API: GET /sessions/{id}/recordings.

url_expires_in.description: Seconds until the recording URLs expire.

tools.name: livestorm_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List all people in the workspace who engaged with one of its events at some point, including team members. Filter by role or email. Livestorm API: GET /people.

role.description: Filter by role, as Livestorm reports it.

email.description: Only the person with this email address.

tools.name: livestorm_get_person
tools.title: Get a person
tools.description: Get one person by id: name, email, role and custom attributes. Livestorm API: GET /people/{id}.

person_id.description: The person id (from livestorm_list_people or livestorm_list_session_people).

tools.name: livestorm_list_event_people
tools.title: List event people
tools.description: List all people linked to any session of one event, with role. Filter by role or email. Livestorm API: GET /events/{id}/people.

role.description: Filter by role, as Livestorm reports it.

email.description: Only the person with this email address.

tools.name: livestorm_list_people_attributes
tools.title: List people attributes
tools.description: List the custom people attributes (registration fields) defined in the workspace. Livestorm API: GET /people_attributes.

name.description: Only attributes whose name matches this text.

tools.name: livestorm_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the team members of the organization, including pending invitations. Needs the admin scope on the API token. Livestorm API: GET /users.

role.description: Filter by role, as Livestorm reports it.

email.description: Only the team member with this email address.

tools.name: livestorm_create_event
tools.title: Create an event
tools.description: Create one new event in the workspace (draft by default), or duplicate an existing one with copy_from_event_id. Creates one event per call. Livestorm API: POST /events.

slug.description: URL slug for the registration page.

status.description: Event status, as Livestorm accepts it (for example 'draft' or 'published').

everyone_can_speak.description: Let all registrants speak in the session.

copy_from_event_id.description: Duplicate this existing event instead of starting empty.

tools.name: livestorm_create_event_session
tools.title: Create an event session
tools.description: Create one new session for an existing event: start time, timezone and name. Creates one session per call. Livestorm API: POST /events/{id}/sessions.

event_id.description: The event id to add the session to.
